page.layout: One block of running text in the right two-thirds of the page, with two marginal notes in the left margin beside the third and fourth paragraphs. The running head "PRÆFATIO" stands above the text, and a small page number stands at the top centre.

main_text.p: [?]Elum, quod ex hujus Magistri schola male feria-ti discipuli complures, ceu ex equo quodam Trojano, prodierint, qui si praeceptoris malitiam non superarint, at adaequarunt tamen. De his succin-ctior futura est nostra narratio.
Vix desierant calere infelicis Serveti cineres, cum domi illi pullulare ceperunt, exorta flamma, quae postea Ecclesias alias reformatas, Poloniam pri-mum, inde Transylvaniam & Hungariam corripuit.

Iohannes Paulus AlciatusInter quos Johannes quidam Paulus Alciatus Mediolanensis Miles, recensetur loco primo, homo stolidi ac vesani ingenii, & plane atque ad rabiem usque phreneticus, qui Fargias Bernatum concessit; Inde in Poloniam devenit, ubi tandem ad Mahumetanos palam defecit, & Alcoranum impurissimum amplexatus.

Valentinus GentilisStrenuus hujus commilito Valentinus extitit Gentilis Consentinus, teterrima Tritheitarum[?] haereseos[?] astipulator. Qui Italica, quatum[?] Geneva erat, Ecclesia Minister, venenum, ꝗ ex lacu-nis Servetanis hauserat, de Deitate Filii secunda-ria, quae ab illâ unicâ Patris ꝑfluxisset, tam atro-cibus contumeliis evomere nō dubitavit, ut nihil unquam magis impurum & detestandum Solis iste conspexerit.

page.notes: The page number at the top centre is a small mark and may be "I" rather than "1"; read as 1 with doubt. The left marginal note "Iohannes Paulus Alciatus" breaks over two lines in the scan and its hyphenation is unclear; joined without a hyphen. The first word of the page is a fragment with a decorated initial and is read as "Elum" with doubt. "Tritheitarum", "haereseos" and "quatum" are doubtful readings. The text of the paragraph beginning "Strenuus" and some words in it may be set in italic type; I have not marked italics there because the scan is unclear. The page ends mid-word at "ad er-", which continues on the next page.
